fields.mechanism: Utilization of diametric magnets in device design to mitigate MRI-related adverse events, specifically reducing dislodgment and migration associated with static magnetic fields.
fields.intervention: Replace or design standard permanent magnets in the medical device housing with diametrically magnetized magnets or passive magnetic shielding materials to minimize net stray fields and torque interactions during MRI exposure.
fields.expected_effect: Reduced incidence of device dislodgment, dislocation, and migration/expulsion, thereby preventing associated patient injuries such as pain and hearing impairment during or after MRI scans.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct in-vitro MRI exposure tests at 1.5T and 3T using prototype devices with diametric magnets versus standard magnet configurations; measure torque forces and displacement vectors; if the diametric configuration does not significantly reduce displacement compared to the standard control under identical field conditions, the mechanism is falsified.

fields.mechanism: Use of diametric magnets in cochlear implants to reduce MRI-related adverse events such as magnet dislodgment, dislocation, migration, and expulsion during magnetic resonance imaging.
fields.intervention: Integrate diametrically magnetized components (or a diametric magnet assembly) into the implantable medical device so that the internal magnet experiences reduced torque and force when the patient undergoes MRI, thereby lowering the risk of magnet dislodgment/dislocation and migration/expulsion.
fields.expected_effect: Decreased incidence of device dislodgment, dislocation, migration/expulsion, and associated patient pain and hearing impairment during and after MRI exposure, reducing unspecified device failures tied to magnetic field interactions.
fields.falsification_test: Compare the rate of MRI-related dislodgment/dislocation and migration/expulsion adverse events (per MAUDE-style reporting) for devices equipped with diametric magnets versus devices with conventional axial magnets across a matched cohort, using a chi-squared test with significance threshold p < 0.05; failure to show a statistically significant reduction falsifies the mechanism.
fields.mechanism_source_span: whether devices with diametric magnets are associated with reduced adverse events.
